SELECT 'access-' || LL.LOG_ID AS ID, 'ACCESS' AS CATEGORY, CASE WHEN LL.RESULT = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'LOGIN_SUCCESS' WHEN LL.RESULT = 'LOGOUT' THEN 'LOGOUT' ELSE 'LOGIN_FAILED' END AS ACTION, CASE WHEN LL.RESULT IN ('SUCCESS', 'LOGOUT') THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'FAILURE' END AS RESULT, LL.LOG_TIME AS OCCURRED_AT, LL.LOG_ID AS SOURCE_ID, LL.MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.ROLE, M.STATUS AS MEMBER_STATUS, M.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID AS IDENTIFIER, LL.FAIL_REASON, CASE LL.FAIL_REASON WHEN 'MEMBER_NOT_FOUND' THEN '회원을 찾을 수 없음' WHEN 'INVALID_PASSWORD' THEN '비밀번호 불일치' WHEN 'ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED' THEN '허용되지 않은 로그인 유형' WHEN 'ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE' THEN '비활성 계정' WHEN 'CONCURRENT_ADMIN_SESSION' THEN '관리자 중복 세션' ELSE LL.FAIL_REASON END AS FAIL_REASON_LABEL, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS SUBSCRIPTION_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS PAYMENT_STATUS, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS MERCHANT_UID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS AMOUNT, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS PLAN_NAME, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS PAID_AT, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS NEXT_BILLING_AT, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS REFUNDED_AT, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS REFUND_AMOUNT, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1000)) AS REFUND_REASON, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS PORTONE_CANCELLATION_ID FROM LOGIN_LOG LL LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = LL.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT 'payment-' || H.HISTORY_ID AS ID, 'PAYMENT' AS CATEGORY, CASE H.STATUS WHEN 'PAID' THEN 'PAYMENT_PAID' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 'PAYMENT_FAILED' WHEN 'READY' THEN 'PAYMENT_READY' WHEN 'CANCELED' THEN 'PAYMENT_CANCELED' WHEN 'REFUNDED' THEN 'PAYMENT_REFUNDED' ELSE 'PAYMENT' END AS ACTION, CASE WHEN H.STATUS = 'READY' THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN H.STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILURE' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END AS RESULT, CASE WHEN H.STATUS = 'PAID' THEN NVL(H.PAID_AT, H.CREATED_AT) WHEN H.STATUS = 'REFUNDED' THEN NVL(H.REFUNDED_AT, NVL(H.PAID_AT, H.CREATED_AT)) ELSE H.CREATED_AT END AS OCCURRED_AT, H.HISTORY_ID AS SOURCE_ID, H.MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.ROLE, M.STATUS AS MEMBER_STATUS, H.UNIV_ID, COALESCE(U.UNIV_NAME, A.UNIV_NAME) AS UNIV_NAME, H.MERCHANT_UID AS IDENTIFIER, H.FAIL_REASON, H.FAIL_REASON AS FAIL_REASON_LABEL, H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, H.STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS, H.MERCHANT_UID, H.PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID, H.PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID, H.AMOUNT, COALESCE(H.PLAN_NAME, P.PLAN_NAME) AS PLAN_NAME, H.PAID_AT, S.NEXT_BILLING_AT, H.REFUNDED_AT, H.REFUND_AMOUNT, H.REFUND_REASON, H.PORTONE_CANCELLATION_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = H.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTIONS S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = H.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_APPLICATIONS A ON A.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
